headline: 2027-2028 school calendar advances, with a Monday staff start; two policies on law enforcement and child abuse reporting still under review.
summary: The calendar starts teachers and ed techs on Monday, August 23rd, with the Friday before students return off, and adds a district shut down week after school ends. Storm days are capped at three before remote learning starts. Committee members will send questions on the two policies by Monday, and a vote is planned for the December 2nd meeting.
decisions: Advanced the 2027-2028 school calendar to the full board, 3-0.
discussion: Election Day at three schools: Members raised safety concerns from staff and asked about other polling sites. The Secretary of State's office must approve any new polling place.

Storm days and remote learning: Up to three storm days can be used before remote learning starts. Meals for families on remote days would be handed out before a storm, under a plan from the food services director.
Law enforcement entry policy: Members asked whether pre-K classrooms run by partner organizations would be covered. Counsel said the policy is mostly required language, with minor changes allowed.
Child abuse reporting policy: A member asked whether families are told when DHHS interviews a student at school. Counsel said the parent is informed when they are not the subject of the report.

decision_evidence.quote: I would like to make a motion to uh advance this version of the 2027-2028 to the full board. Is there a second? ... Okay, so this version of the calendar will be advanced to the full board.

problems.what: recommended, but the decision or the minutes don't say so
